thread:
Jordan (CSM): Hey team — Harpswell week0 check. They're on track for private/VPC but reported two blockers: KMS access errors and audit forwarding failing cert validation. Need quick owners.

Priya (CS Ops): I built a focused runbook section: /runbooks/harpswell/week0. It lists required firewall egress, IAM trust sample, and KMS policy example. I've linked their infra contacts.

Luca (NetEng): From network troubleshooting: their spoke subnets are fine, but return traffic from our edge is SNAT'd incorrectly at their NAT instance. I requested their NAT instance config and security group.

Sam (Security): KMS: observed kms:Decrypt and kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext errors in our logs. Their key policy currently allows only principals from within their account. They must add our cross-account role ARN with those actions.

Heather (Solutions): For audit logs, their Splunk HEC cert CN is a wildcard (*.examplecorp.com) but the cert presented was for splunk.internal. CN mismatch caused TLS handshake fail. They plan certificate rotation today.

Jordan (CSM): Good — action items: Priya send IAM & KMS snippets; Luca confirm NAT fix; Sam validate key policy after change; Heather coordinate cert rotation and re-test.

Priya (CS Ops): Sent IAM trust example to their infra lead. Snippet includes ExternalId requirement. Also added KMS snippet that grants kms:Decrypt and kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext to arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-inference.

Luca (NetEng): Customer updated NAT config — they missed source/dest check on the ENI. Once disabled, return path works in our synthetic tests. Please ask them to promote this change to prod.

OpsBot: Automated check: IAM AssumeRole test success = true; KMS decrypt test = failed (error: AccessDenied); Splunk HEC TLS = failed (CN mismatch). Tickets: OPS-8123, OPS-8124.

Sam (Security): Key policy change requested by their KMS admin. They applied a permissions statement but used an IAM condition that blocks the GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext action. I've provided exact minimal statement to include. Waiting on final apply.

Heather (Solutions): They rotated Splunk cert and validated chain. HEC now accepts our test event. Will keep an eye for intermittent failures.

Jordan (CSM): Nice. If KMS fix lands today we can flip the account health to green. Priya, please capture a renewal-watch note: customer requires immutable audit retention 2 years; this will affect ops cost baseline.

Priya (CS Ops): Noted and added renewal-watch: "Audit retention 720d (2y) request — requires billing approval and contract amendment."

Sam (Security): KMS policy applied successfully. Re-run shows decrypt and generate-data-key-without-plaintext passing.

OpsBot: Final scan: connectivity=ok, iam=ok, kms=ok, audit-forwarding=ok. Closing automated checks.

Jordan (CSM): Thanks all. I'll confirm with Harpswell that they're happy to schedule cutover Thursday. Closing thread unless new issues surface.

Luca (NetEng): :+1:

Heather (Solutions): I'll send cutover checklist to customer.

Priya (CS Ops): Runbook updated with final verbiage and timestamps.

Sam (Security): Closing on my end."
